summary: Full backend + public frontend testing of CMS Universale Fase 1. All 10 pytest cases pass (content-sections=6, draft/published visibility, PATCH, duplicate, DELETE, invalid section 404, seed studi-biblici returns 2 items, category+search filters, admin auth guard 401, seeds untouched). Public guest flow verified end-to-end: Welcome -> Continua come Ospite -> Home banner Biblioteca -> Hub with 5 categories (Podcast, Meditazioni, Studi Biblici, Predicazioni, Video) -> Studi Biblici list with 2 seed items and category chips (Tutti/Vangeli/Antico Testamento) -> Item detail with YouTube embed player, share/download buttons, tags and next-item navigation. api.ts strip-undefined fix confirmed working (no 'section=undefined' regression). No draft leakage. Admin panel not tested (behind Google gate as instructed).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 3362 lines - well over the 700-line guideline; consider splitting CMS/admin/reports into routers.
GET /api/contents uses status='published' but also visibility filter; ensure a default 'visibility=public' is written on legacy docs (current code only sets when creating via POST).
duplicate endpoint copies media_id (shared GridFS ref) - already handled in DELETE via ref-count, good.
publish_date is stored as ISO string but sorted alongside None; sort with mixed types can be unstable in Mongo - consider a stored datetime.
seed_data_creation: Seeds cnt_seed1 & cnt_seed2 already present and preserved. All test-created TEST_ contents cleaned up via fixture teardown - verified 0 remaining in DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin login: pescatoridiuomini@outlook.it / AdminTestPwd1! (any password works for allowlist admin). Frontend admin gated by Google welcome, not automatable - only public flow via /welcome -> 'Continua come Ospite'. CMS routes: GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE /api/admin/contents, GET /api/contents?section=..., GET /api/content-sections. 6 sections defined. Seeds cnt_seed1 (Il Sermone sul Monte) & cnt_seed2 (La Fede di Abramo) in 'studi-biblici' - do NOT delete.
rca_of_issue: N/A - all functionality working as designed. The 'undefined' param strip fix in /app/frontend/src/api.ts (contents/adminContents build clean object filtering undefined/null/empty before URLSearchParams) is correctly implemented and verified via passing tests.
